profile.headline: Software Developer @ Dorger Software Architects | Computer Science
profile.summary:
In my most recent role as a Software Analyst, I developed cross-browser-compatible React applications using component libraries like MUI, based on detailed UX wireframes. I created and modified Type-GraphQL resolvers and used Apollo Client to efficiently consume and integrate data from the server into the frontend. These skills enabled me to introduce exciting new features that enhanced the user experience and ensured smooth data handling between server and client.

I wrote comprehensive unit tests using Jest to ensure the quality and reliability of my code, resulting in robust and secure applications. I collaborated with senior leadership, stakeholders, and DevOps teams to shape a solid technological support structure. I am passionate about professional growth and constantly challenge myself to expand my expertise in Full Stack development and stay updated on cutting-edge technologies.

I am interested in connecting with former colleagues and managers, as well as other professionals in my field. Feel free to contact me through this profile if you wish to connect.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and developed application components for business workflows and system functionality.  
• Debugged and resolved application issues to improve system reliability and user experience. 
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to deliver application enhancements and technical solutions.
• Supported reliable and maintainable application functionality for business-critical workflows.
• Applied ability to work independently to research and implement new technologies, enhancing software func-tionality and performance.

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description:
• Ensured adherence to software design best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
• Developed and maintained full-stack web applications supporting business workflows and data-driven functionality.
• Designed user-focused dashboard interfaces to improve workflow visibility and operational usability.
• Collaborated with designers to translate Figma wireframes into responsive, user-focused frontend interfaces.
• Developed and integrated REST APIs to support application features and data workflows.
• Participated in Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment workflows and Agile development processes to support reliable software delivery.
• Used Git-based version control workflows to manage code changes and support team collaboration.
• Worked with relational databases and backend services to support application functionality and data workflows.

positions.locationName: Baton Rouge, Louisiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:

showcasing strong coding skills and in-depth knowledge of front-end development best practices.
• Applied Agile and Design Thinking practices proficiently throughout application development, earning

programming fundamentals, software design, enterprise development, testing, and support, contributing
to a well-rounded and versatile skill set.
